caption: The drawing depicts a single canopy bed with four tall, turned wooden posts supporting a rectangular canopy frame at the top. The wood of the posts and the headboard is colored a reddish-brown, with visible grain patterns and a slightly shiny finish. The headboard is rounded at the top and has two symmetrical decorative cutouts. The bed is dressed with a light-colored, possibly white or off-white, fabric that covers the mattress and hangs down to form a skirt around the lower part of the bed. The canopy is also covered in a matching light-colored fabric that drapes down with a scalloped edge. The entire bed is centered within a thin, rectangular border drawn in black pencil or pen, and the background is plain and uncolored, showing only the texture of the paper.
title: Four Poster Bed
